# IArkWithSwap
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/IArkWithSwap.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IArk](./i-ark.md)

**Title:**
IArkWithSwap

Interface for Arks that can exit positions through a curator-whitelisted DEX-aggregator
router swap (`withdrawUsingSwap`), with a curator-configured slippage bound.

Split out of `IArkWithWithdrawalRequest` so synchronous Arks (e.g. swap-based RWA Arks) can
use the router-swap machinery without inheriting the async-withdrawal surface.
`IArkWithWithdrawalRequest` inherits this interface, so existing consumers are unaffected.


## Functions
### withdrawUsingSwap

Withdraws assets from the Ark using a swap

This function is only callable by the keeper

This function is non-reentrant


```solidity
function withdrawUsingSwap(uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to withdraw|
|`data`|`bytes`|The data to pass to the swap (router and swap calldata)|


### setSlippage

Sets the slippage for the swap

the base is 10000 so 500 is 5%

This function is only callable by the curator


```solidity
function setSlippage(uint256 slippage) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`slippage`|`uint256`|The slippage to set|


### whitelistRouter

Whitelists a router

This function is only callable by the curator


```solidity
function whitelistRouter(address router, bool isWhitelisted) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`router`|`address`|The router to whitelist|
|`isWhitelisted`|`bool`|The boolean to set the whitelist to|


## Events
### RouterWhitelisted
Emitted when a router's whitelist status is updated.


```solidity
event RouterWhitelisted(address router, bool isWhitelisted);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`router`|`address`|The router address whose status changed.|
|`isWhitelisted`|`bool`|The new whitelist status.|

### SlippageSet
Emitted when `setSlippage` updates the swap slippage tolerance.


```solidity
event SlippageSet(uint256 slippage);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`slippage`|`uint256`|The new slippage value, in basis points of `SLIPPAGE_BASE`.|

### Swapped
Emitted by `_swap` after a successful router call.


```solidity
event Swapped(address token, address router, uint256 amount, bytes swapCalldata);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|The sold token address.|
|`router`|`address`|The router address that executed the swap.|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of `token` sold.|
|`swapCalldata`|`bytes`|The calldata forwarded to the router.|

## Errors
### RouterNotWhitelisted
Error thrown when a router is not whitelisted


```solidity
error RouterNotWhitelisted();
```

### SlippageTooHigh
Error thrown when the slippage is too high


```solidity
error SlippageTooHigh();
```

### ReceivedLessThanExpected
Error thrown when the received amount is less than expected


```solidity
error ReceivedLessThanExpected();
```

## Structs
### SwapData
Struct for the swap data


```solidity
struct SwapData {
    /// @notice The router address
    address router;
    /// @notice The swap data
    bytes swapCalldata;
}
```
